data.title: Palm Jebel Ali
data.about:
Discover the pinnacle of luxury at Palm Jebel Ali by Nakheel, situated in the iconic Palm Jebel Ali.  Select from a stunning collection of Beach Villas and Coral Villas Designed with meticulous attention to detail, each villa offers a harmonious blend of contemporary design and unmatched comfort, seamlessly connecting the splendor of the sea, sky, and a stunning beachfront to your living space. 

Be captivated by the dynamic spaces within, featuring seven magnificent ensuite bedrooms, formal living spaces, and provisions for both a guard’s house and a double maid’s room, all orchestrated to serve diverse lifestyles with utmost grace.

Immerse yourself in a life of luxury, where every moment is a testament to passion and perfection, only at The Palm Jebel Ali by Nakheel.

location_tile.title: Situated on Palm Jebel Ali
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the paradisiacal archipelago of Palm Jebel Ali, residents can enjoy the longest coastline in Dubai, offering a unique perspective on the city's skyline from a tranquil haven. Just minutes away from the vibrant heart of the city and seamlessly connected to other Dubai destinations and Abu Dhabi through Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), it stands as a pinnacle in Dubai's rapidly developing southern urban center, promising a harmonious blend of luxury and convenience.

  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes to  Downtown Dubai
  • 30 minutes to the Mall of the Emirates
  • 35 Minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)
